'''Sen T'jore''' is a region on the [[Seanchan]] [[Seanchan (continent)|continent]]. From the references, it seems to be just an area of land and not a town or village.

[[Suroth Sabelle Meldarath]] owned a decorative panel with an image of a [[kori|great spotted cat]] that originated from Sen T'jore.{{ref/book|4|1}} [[Kennar Miraj]] once mused that his enemies seemed to spring out of the ground like trap-worms from Sen T'jore.{{ref/book|8|24}}
